d: A field of Venice. To the right of the spectator is a spices shop with the sign of the "two scimie" , decorated to make the subject. Various porters outside beat, others are sifting drugs; a coffee shop. In front of a trattoria with exhibition. On the left, ahead, the small house of Crispino, further back the door of a palace.
Said and Don Asdrubale, who goes from the palace to the coffee. The porters leave to beat, and wait for other tasks.
Said and Annetta with a basket full of stories and songs. Mirabolano will be seen in the pharmacy.
Annetta and Don Asdrubale.
Don Asdrubale, and Dr. Fabrizio, who is out of the palace.
Dr. Fabrizio.
Remote place with a well in the middle. Crispin, puffed up and pierced, comes running.
Crispino and the Comare.
Crispino alone.
Crispino, then Annetta.
A field as in the scene before the first act. Crispino and Annetta are cheerful and arm-to-arm.
Drowning alone.
Mirabolano, then Don Fabrizio from the pharmacy, Don Asdrubale from the house, the Young from the shops and People. The Comare appears in time.
Says and Crispinus, who comes out of his house in black dress.
That said, the hasty Continum, Annetta from the house, then Bortolo mason, followed by a lot of people.
Say, less Annetta, Bortolo and Contino.
Say, Annetta and the Contino from the house.
Field as in the first scene of the first act, with the only difference, that the house of Crispino will be greatly rebuilt there. There will be a poggiuolo workable. Dr. Fabrizio and the Contino.
Interior of the spices shop at the    . Two scimie.Mirabolano alone is walking.
Said and Crispino entering with gravity charged.
Says and Dr. Fabrizio.
Lounge in the house of Don Asdrubale. Asdrubale, and several Doctors who enter seriously, dressed in their robes and covered in the masterly cap.
Said, Crispino, Fabrizio, Mirabolano, Contino, all in toga, then Lisetta in time.
Say, less Mirabolano and Asdrubale.
Said, and Mirabolano coming back.
Crispino and the Doctors.
Lounge in Crispino's house. Annetta and various Parents and Friends of hers. Servants set a table with pancakes, bottles and more.
Said and Crispino, who appeared on the door suddenly.
Crispino, managed to open the door, is impressed by the appearance of the Comare, which if presented to him on the door.

Underground. Next are two large colossus of white stone above black bases; the one on the right of the spectator represents Time the one on the left of the Judgment. In the middle is a mirror. The Comare and Crispino, which follows her trembling.
Crispino falls unconscious over the chair, and the scene turns into a room of his house, where he is surrounded by the Sons, Annetta, Fabrizio, Mirabolano, the Continent, various Friends and Parents.
